changes.comment: BREAKING (implementers only): host helpers. New host packlet: openOrInitializeTaskRepository opens or initializes a repository at a root in the strongest mode the root qualifies for, with an explicit labelled in-memory fallback, and trustedKindAuthority returns a fixed ITaskAuthorization for trusted host principals (a Result; empty lists are refused). probeTaskRepositoryRoot exports the mode probe the repository uses (atomicReplace required). FileTreeTaskRepository.openOrInitialize decides open-versus-initialize under exclusive ownership. The manifest records initializedMode (backfilled by the first durable open of an older manifest); opening a process-crash repository as session needs allowSessionOverDurable. A change-scopes access request now carries the resulting scope set in scopes. Storage refuses to adopt a landed first record whose scopes differ from the registration's draft. TaskBroker gains whenIdle (never takes the writer, injected schedule), a writeGuard option around every broker write, and resumePendingRegistration for external registrations; IBoundTaskWriter gains resumePendingRegistration, IBoundTaskDelivery gains issued(), and ITaskRepository gains pendingRegistration (with landedScopes).
